description: Diputación de Pontevedra: wastewater datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación de Pontevedra. Coverage: Diputación de Pontevedra. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about wastewater; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Depuradoras de la provincia de Pontevedra; Colectores de la provincia de Pontevedra; Red de saneamiento de la provincia de Pontevedra. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://ide.depo.gal/web/idepo/aviso-legal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
